scenes.heading: Building a simple sales funnel from content to customer

sents.d: Building a simple sales funnel from content to customer
Content without a next step rarely converts into revenue on its own.
A funnel simply means guiding someone from first noticing you, to trusting you, to eventually buying — content alone at the 'noticing' stage rarely converts without a defined next step.

A basic funnel might look like: helpful public content (attracting attention), a specific lead magnet in exchange for an email address (building a direct line of communication), a short automated email sequence (building trust), and a clear, low-friction offer (converting to a sale).

Auditing your current content against this structure often reveals a gap — many small businesses have plenty of top-of-funnel content but no clear path guiding an interested follower toward actually buying.

take: Give every follower a clear next step toward buying.
